// diagnostic

E0082

`&&` and `||` are mixed here without parentheses

What

`&&` and `||` are mixed here without parentheses

Why

`&&` binds tighter than `||`, but readers often misjudge that, so Jet asks you to show the grouping

Fix

Write `{grouped}` to keep today's meaning, or regroup the conditions the way you intended

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0082: tests/ui/logic_mix_and_then_or.stderr.

Error [E0082]: `&&` and `||` are mixed here without parentheses

    |
  5 |     print(a && b || c)
    |           ^^^^^^
 Why: `&&` binds tighter than `||`, but readers often misjudge that, so Jet asks you to show the grouping
 Fix: Write `(a && b)` to keep today's meaning, or regroup the conditions the way you intended
